name: Adobe Analytics MCP
description: Run Adobe Analytics and Customer Journey Analytics reports, find metrics and build segments from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor via Adobe-hosted MCP servers, for analysts.

skills.name: Run Report
skills.description: Runs Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics reports on chosen dimensions and metrics for a report suite or data view.

skills.name: Find Components
skills.description: Finds report suites, data views, dimensions, metrics, segments, date ranges and Workspace projects by name.

skills.name: Build Segments
skills.description: Creates or updates segments, calculated metrics and date ranges in Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics.

skills.name: Component Usage
skills.description: Lists where a component is used, what it is frequently used with, and similar components, to help tidy up reporting.

skills.name: Workspace Projects
skills.description: Describes, creates and updates Analysis Workspace projects from natural-language requests in an MCP client.
